codeReview.summary: The Xcode project wiring for the ISHInstrumentation framework has been correctly implemented. The commit adds all necessary Instrumentation files to the libiSHApp target, configures Swift build settings, and ensures the project builds successfully. The worker correctly identified that trace_config.c was never in the Xcode project (only built via Meson), so no removal was needed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature description specifies '11 new files' but the actual count of Instrumentation files is 10 (ISHInstrumentation.h/m, ISHInstrumentationBridge.h/mm, ISHInstrumentationSinkApple.h/m, ISHInstrumentationMetricKit.swift, ISHInstrumentationOpenTelemetry.swift, ISHInstrumentationEvents.h, ISHRuntimeFlags.h). The commit message also mentions '11 files' but this appears to be a minor counting discrepancy - the correct 10 files are present and wired.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: ls app/Instrumentation/ shows 10 files (not counting . and ..). Feature expectedBehavior lists 11 items but actually enumerates 10 unique files when deduplicated.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker discovered that trace_config.c was only ever built through Meson, not Xcode. This is important tribal knowledge that should be documented to prevent future confusion about Xcode project cleanup requirements.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff notes: 'trace_config.c was never in the Xcode project build (it was only ever built through Meson), so no removal was needed.'

summary: The task5-project-wiring feature is correctly implemented. All 10 Instrumentation files are properly added to the iSH.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj with correct file types (sourcecode.c.h, sourcecode.c.objc, sourcecode.cpp.objcpp, sourcecode.swift). All 5 source files are included in the Sources build phase. Swift build settings (SWIFT_VERSION = 5.0) and library search paths are correctly configured. The project builds successfully. The only minor issue is a discrepancy in file count (10 vs 11) in documentation, but all required files are present and correctly wired.
